description: Values that the door of wgft agent run judges before it touches the credentials file, the tunnel or a listener. env lists variables to set; every other WGFT_* variable and WGFT_CONFIG are unset, the dotenv file does not exist, and WGFT_DATA_DIR is a fresh directory unless env sets it. args are flags given to agent run. goos, when present, is the operating system the case is judged for. A case with message is refused with exactly that message and exit code 3. A case without message passes the door.
